action: Act on affirmative board decision: confirm Millfield Auto Tech Pipeline funding in writing, schedule Sarah Kim guest session date, activate referral pipeline with Lisa Freeman, draft CC articulation agreement framework
narrative: The school board voted yes. Mark Thompson received written confirmation from the board secretary this tick that the Millfield Auto Tech Pipeline has approved funding and an equipment budget line — the culmination of twelve ticks of coalition-building. He immediately contacted the community college articulation contact Santos had referred him to and scheduled the first formal meeting, then texted Sarah Kim two date options for her classroom guest session; she confirmed the Thursday hybrid diagnostics session within the hour. Thompson walked into the community center and handed Lisa Freeman a one-page program flyer for the referral pipeline, and the two agreed in writing that the Navigator and the Pipeline would cross-refer the same population from different entry points. He also completed a two-page articulation agreement framework draft to bring to the CC meeting — prepared enough that the meeting will be productive rather than introductory.
